neighbours.label: The completing word of two fixed pairs: 'class' after 'middle' (middle class, middle-class) and 'out' after 'close' (close out, closed out); other X class and close X / X out combinations are silent
fire: The new tax credit mainly benefits middle-class households in the suburbs.
The choir will close out the festival with a Bach cantata.
Few middle class families could afford a second car in the 1950s.
A double from the veteran batsman closed out the innings.
Suburban middle-class voters decided the election.
The fireworks closed out the celebrations just after midnight.
Rising rents are squeezing the middle class out of the city.
The band likes to close out every set with the same ballad.
quiet: The new tax credit mainly benefits working-class households in the suburbs.
The choir will open the festival with a Bach cantata.
Few upper class families kept a second car in the 1950s.
A double from the veteran batsman closed the gap in the innings.
Suburban lower-class voters decided the election.
The fireworks went out just after midnight.
Rising rents are pushing the ruling class out of the city.
The band likes to close every set with the same ballad.
